title: A Soroban operation's source account is stored in its muxed M form
severity_basis: A muxed source reached an account column un-reduced (one producer of issue #716). Fixed upstream by PR #753 (bb0b162b); the linter fires at the pre-fix commit and is silent after (make lint-before-after).

entries.observed: XDR102: xdr.MuxedAccount.Address() renders the M… form of a muxed account; it reaches a participant set (NewThreadUnsafeSet) at line 156 without being reduced to the base account (ToAccountId) or kind-checked

history.note: Created by xcc findings new from report row lint:github.com/stellar/wallet-backend@f8e5786d:XDR102:internal/indexer/processors/contract_operations.go:participantsForSorobanOp.
Pre-fix side of a public upstream fix.

The replay shows the same defect: at 79ea2acd the Soroban operations' muxed source is stored as a participant in its M form on the Protocol 28 local-core chains (cap-0046/soroban-ops-with-muxed-source, both passphrases, both inputs of make verify-replay); the known divergence names this record and its rows are listed.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 1 of 1 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0007.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the fix itself is the evidence and the linter row is the pre-fix side of the before/after table.
